say:2:1423342001:1.text: Orlana, you look a little down...
say:2:1423342001:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你看起来心情有点低落……

choice_prompt:3:1423342001.text: Orlana, you look a little down...
choice_prompt:3:1423342001.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你看起来心情有点低落……

say:4:1423342002:1.text: Probably because I see myself in those kids...
say:4:1423342002:1.source_cn: 可能因为我觉得那些孩子和我很像吧……

say:5:1423342003:1.text: Back then, I only had one goal: become a priestess. And when I felt lost, I'd bury myself in books. It helped me forget everything else...
say:5:1423342003:1.source_cn: 以前的我只有努力成为祭司这一个念头，迷茫的时候都会逼自...

say:6:1423342004:1.text: Now that I've let go of that path... I don't know what I'm good for anymore.
say:6:1423342004:1.source_cn: 现在要抛弃作为祭司学到的一切重新开始……却发现自己什么...

say:7:1423342005:1.text: ... I feel lost, uncertain, unsure how to move forward... I wonder if those kids feel the same.
say:7:1423342005:1.source_cn: ……迷茫，无处可去，不知道未来该做什么，觉得自己没有准...

say:8:1423342006:1.text: But at least I met you guys. You helped me visit the commoners' district and gave me the courage to take that first step. Those kids weren't that lucky...
say:8:1423342006:1.source_cn: 但我起码遇到了你们，你们帮助我实现了去平民区看看的愿望...

choice_prompt:9:1423342006.text: But at least I met you guys. You helped me visit the commoners' district and gave me the courage to take that first step. Those kids weren't that lucky...
choice_prompt:9:1423342006.source_cn: 但我起码遇到了你们，你们帮助我实现了去平民区看看的愿望，还鼓励我迈出第一步，可那些孩子却没有这样的运气……

say:10:1423342007:1.text: But I haven't even figured out my own future yet... Is it really okay for me to try?
say:10:1423342007:1.source_cn: 可是我连自己的未来都没有想明白……我是不是太不自量力了？

say:11:1423342008:1.text: You're doing great, Orlana! But if you're still feeling down, how about we go somewhere else next time to relax a bit?
say:11:1423342008:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜你已经很努力了！如果你还是不开心的话，不如我们下...

say:12:1423342009:1.source_cn: 这样逃避下去总不是办法……

say:13:1423342010:1.text: Thank you. I want to take some time to think about everything...
say:13:1423342010:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！我想一个人好好思考一下，关于未来的事……

choice:9:0:1.text: Maybe you can be that person for them.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你可以想办法帮帮他们
choice:9:0:1.male: Maybe you can be that person for them.
choice:9:0:1.female: Maybe you can be that person for them.

choice:9:1:2.text: Start small. Do what you can.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 可以做些能帮到他们的小事
choice:9:1:2.male: Start small. Do what you can.
choice:9:1:2.female: Start small. Do what you can.

choice:3:0:1.text: Why did you give Jamie that book?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜为什么把书送给了詹米？
choice:3:0:1.male: Why did you give Jamie that book?
choice:3:0:1.female: Why did you give Jamie that book?
